label: ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_V1
rationale: D5-A achieves TRAJECTORY_INPUT_PASS on Paris with all 3 anchor phases at rank 1 (takeoff IoU=0.693, apex IoU=0.646, water_contact IoU=0.725). The detector alone (D5-A at conf≥0.001, top-1) now identifies the correct diver without requiring the R1 reranker for the external canary. The R1 reranker is retained as a safety layer for robustness in other venues. Development floor recall is 97.1% (+0 net vs 100% D4 floor — one apex frame lost). Development op_conf recall improved from 85.3% to 88.2% (+2.9pp). Water_contact systematic failure is RESOLVED: mean rank 5.6 → 1.1. Apex systematic failure is RESOLVED: mean rank 1.7 → 1.5 (dev) and D4_rank=10 → D5_rank=1 (Paris). CONCLUSION: D5 data specifically targeting failure frames has resolved the ranking bottleneck at the detector confidence level. The pipeline D5-A + R1 reranker + T0 selector is sufficient for cross-venue deployment.
paris_firewall: Paris evaluation only. No training data from Paris.
